newBoundary: currentInputLink/jointTraceId/fixed Git closure through real decode and E4 publication

scope.limitation: Short-lived unobserved children may be missed; this is not an exhaustive fork audit.

measurements.scope: Browser process and its observed descendants; Python/export/reference processes excluded
measurements.rssNote: Sum of process RSS double-counts shared pages; do not add RSS and PSS
measurements.pssNote: Sum of Linux proportional set sizes sampled around 100 ms; not exact peak or total device RAM
measurements.cpuNote: Observed cumulative process CPU seconds; exited processes may disappear between samples
